A.question: Multiplicidad sin y con Bonferroni
A.estimand: Paired difference of estimation/prediction error under specified DGP
A.outcome_proxy: counts, proportions or loss, not political virtue
A.interference: Session and group shocks only when explicitly simulated

B.H1: Searching 20 true-null hypotheses raises familywise false positives
B.H0: Uncorrected and Bonferroni FWER equal at 0.05
B.H_others: Familywise multiple testing inflates chance findings without correction.

C.design: 600 complete null test families of 20 independent z-tests
C.falsifier: Paired mean difference crosses zero or shifts sign under ablation/alternative DGP
C.budget: 600 paired DGP realizations, 500 bootstrap resamples of independent draws
C.multiplicity: 30 exploratory claims, no unadjusted confirmatory testing

D.controls: Competent same-information baseline, except C23/C26 explicitly compare unequal-information arms to diagnose unfair advantage

F.strongest_rival: Familywise multiple testing inflates chance findings without correction.
F.adversarial_audit: Monte Carlo conditions are stipulated; no transport to real Spanish institutions.
F.selection_exposure: Preset seed and tests, but one modeled DGP; model choice informed by known literature.
F.risk: Self-constructed endpoint and same DGP can mechanically favor one treatment.

G.synthetic_mc: 600 independent generated realizations, not independent empirical cohorts.

H.posterior_update: No calibrated numerical posterior; descriptive or conditional update only.
H.abductive_rival: Familywise multiple testing inflates chance findings without correction.

I.internal_validity: Only conditional on generator, unit design and code
I.reproducibility: Re-executable given frozen code/source and seed

J.reason: Another similar source snapshot or DGP realization is not an independent external validation.
